entries.symptom: WeeklyGoalCalendarValidationIntegrationTests registration returns HTTP 500 when its frozen Sunday clock yields an email-confirmation expiry earlier than the real domain clock; CI c6f318e5d job 115333479231 failed before calendar assertions.
entries.cause: RegisterCommandHandler computes confirmation expiry from the injected clock plus 24 hours; User.SetEmailConfirmationToken validates future expiry against DomainTime.UtcNow. The calendar fixture freezes the host at Sunday 20:30 UTC, so registration setup becomes expired after Monday 20:30 UTC.
entries.fix: Register and issue valid authentication through the normal PostgreSQL host; create the frozen-clock host for calendar PUT/GET afterward. Preserve genuine JWT authentication, weekly validation and persisted calendar-label assertions.

entries.symptom: Recognition smoke repeatedly times out waiting for an enabled Analyze photo button to become stable on Linux; the footer alternates by about 8 pixels.
entries.cause: Overflow detection adds gutter and inline padding. Narrower square image content becomes shorter and no longer overflows, so the observer removes the gutter and immediately restores overflow.
entries.fix: Reserve the default dialog gutter independently of overflow state; keep the edge inset policy unchanged. Wait for rendered cover selection in the smoke flow and retain failed browser traces in CI.
verification: Ubuntu 26.04, Node 22.23.4, Chromium 156: unchanged six-case command failed before and passed 6/6 after; test hash 361FE37E64D682C70B811303FA93F146DB304E3759F18E798E85FE18490F0222.
60 animation-frame samples showed two footer positions before and one after at desktop and 390px; UI-kit 644 passed and admin smoke 15 passed.

entries.symptom: The git commit command wrapper times out while pre-commit validation is still running.
entries.cause: The repository pre-commit hook runs formatting, linters, and tests and can outlive a short command timeout; the commit may already have completed.
entries.fix: Inspect git status and git log -1 before retrying. If the commit did not complete, inspect the newest file under .git/hook-logs, fix the reported failure, and rerun git commit with hooks enabled.

entries.symptom: The git push command wrapper times out while the pre-push test suites continue running.
entries.cause: The repository pre-push hook runs full frontend and backend verification and may exceed a short command timeout.
entries.fix: Inspect the remote branch state, git status, and git log -1 before retrying. If the push failed, inspect .git/hook-logs, resolve the failing suite, and rerun git push without bypassing hooks.

entries.symptom: CI reports WHITESPACE formatting failures after an EF Core migration is added or regenerated.
entries.cause: Generated migration, designer, or model snapshot files do not match the repository whitespace rules.
entries.fix: Run dotnet format whitespace for FoodDiary.Infrastructure, retain both migration files, and confirm generated migration and snapshot classes remain excluded from coverage.

entries.symptom: On a fresh clone, the governed-delivery focused regression rejects FailurePrediction with Assessment inputs changed while running; CI d04aa2965, run 39583146487.
entries.cause: The cache hashes an absent telemetry registry, then the read-only prediction initializes its empty registry. The before and after input hashes differ even though no evidence or source changed.
entries.fix: Initialize the empty telemetry baseline before fingerprinting assessments that consume it. Continue rejecting real source, evidence, policy or telemetry drift during execution.
verification: Reproduced in Linux with Node 22.23.3, PowerShell 7.6.6 and SDK 10.0.102: .artifacts/wiki-ci-repair/linux-feedback-before.log
Linux governed-delivery passed including isolated absent telemetry and in-flight source drift: .artifacts/wiki-ci-repair/linux-governed-after.log

entries.symptom: Workspace audit critique rejects a valid saved confidence ledger with Confidence ledger hash is invalid after crossing an assessment process boundary; CI d04aa2965, run 39583146487.
entries.cause: The audit preserves JSON dates as strings, while a fresh worker uses automatic timestamp parsing. Re-serializing the rehydrated CLR date changes the persisted payload hash.
entries.fix: Apply the existing LlmWikiJson string-date policy in the observed worker and assessment caller before reading JSON. Preserve independent hash and tamper validation.
verification: Original Workspace audit reproduced all three CI errors in Linux: .artifacts/wiki-ci-repair/linux-workspace-before.log
Linux governed-delivery passed including saved confidence ledger verification in a fresh worker: .artifacts/wiki-ci-repair/linux-governed-after.log

entries.symptom: LLM Wiki CI intermittently fails the index-selection smoke after a successful concurrent index refresh; the waiter reruns or misses the lock overlap window.
entries.cause: The concurrency regression used a roughly three-second domain-data generator. Under parallel Linux runner load, the parent can observe lock ownership near process completion and start the waiter after the owner releases the lock.
entries.fix: Use the slower single-generator runtime-topology refresh and retry up to three times only when lock ownership or the overlap window was lost; every successful attempt must still observe the exclusive lock and concurrent receipt reuse.
verification: Run Test-LlmWikiConcurrentIndexUpdate.ps1 on Windows and Linux, then run Invoke-LlmWikiAffectedSmoke.ps1 -Group index-selection.

entries.symptom: CI b07f5bc46 Full Workspace audit failed model-routing degradation assertions after a real task outcome was committed.
entries.cause: The smoke cohort expected exactly three synthetic events but read the accumulated canonical model-routing-outcomes registry, producing four events and allowing unrelated history to influence route health.
entries.fix: Use the existing model-outcome registry override with a fresh fixture-local registry for the audit. Preserve strict cohort, degradation and escalation assertions; restore the previous override and assert the canonical registry hash is unchanged.
verification: ./.llm-wiki/tools/Test-LlmWikiTools.ps1 -Profile Full -AuditShard Workspace passed in 667.92s with a nonempty canonical registry.
Canonical model-outcome registry SHA-256 preservation assertion passed; .artifacts/ci-wiki-repair-workspace.log.
